CHIEF COMPLAINT
Followup of chronic problems.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Bruce is a 60-year-old male presenting for followup of depression, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension. Patient reports it has been a stressful year and a half. He experienced significant anxiety and pressure preparing for Thanksgiving. He had a nice holiday seeing family after about two years, though it was stressful and involved a lot of work. He is planning a vacation for the new year to somewhere warm.

Regarding depression: Patient tried long walks outside every morning during the summer when weather was nice, which he enjoyed and which encouraged yard work and outdoor activity. However, he has been unable to continue with the season change and cold weather. He is not ready to try medications and would like to explore alternative options. Patient denies suicidal or homicidal ideation.

Regarding diabetes: Patient got through Halloween okay but did not stick to diet during Thanksgiving week. He is trying to monitor his intake better now.

Regarding hypertension: Patient purchased a blood pressure cuff as recommended. Readings have been moderate and nothing out of the ordinary. He reports no problems with lisinopril.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, blood in stool, or weight loss.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Depression
Type 2 diabetes mellitus
Hypertension

MEDICATIONS
Metformin
Lisinopril

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Recently attended Thanksgiving gathering. Planning vacation. Was walking outdoors and doing yard work during summer months.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital signs: Blood pressure good.
Neck: No carotid bruits appreciated.
Cardiovascular: Slight 2/6 systolic ejection murmur heard at left base (previously noted).
Pulmonary: Lungs clear bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ non-pitting edema bilaterally in lower extremities.

RESULTS
EKG: No concerning findings. No evidence of acute pathology.
Hemoglobin A1C: Elevated at 8 (goal <6).

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Depression: Referral to psychiatry for talk therapy.
2. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Increase metformin to 1000 mg twice daily. Order hemoglobin A1C in a couple of months. Order lipid panel.
3. Hypertension: Order echocardiogram to recheck systolic ejection murmur. Continue lisinopril 20 mg daily.
